title: Extracellular vesicle-based cancer panels diagnose glioblastomas with high sensitivity and specificity
description: This study focused on the development of serum extracellular vesicle (EV)-based glioblastoma tumor marker panels that can be used in the clinic to diagnose glioblastomas. Overall design: Comparative gene expression profiling analysis of RNA-seq data for serum samples from glioblastoma and control patients.
